codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Extract durable working preferences from recent Cursor chats and convert them into skills, rules, or workflow docs. Use when asked to learn preferences, mine feedback, personalize workflows, or generate team/person-specific agent guidance.

native_mapping.fallback: Native history acquisition is unavailable; supply one exact project-local JSONL export and receive a redacted proposal without durable writeback.

external_dependencies: Cursor chat history or supplied Codex record
permission_gates: Use only the exact parent record, redact secrets, and propose artifacts for approval.
A missing or mismatched transcript yields incomplete evidence and no write.
Respect the current task scope, selected model/effort, repository ownership, and explicit approval requirements.

behavioral_proof.positive: A bounded local JSONL export for one parent thread and its child evidence produced corroborated preference atoms, confidence labels, a redacted project-local proposal and a receipt without raw excerpts or durable writeback.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: Missing native history or a missing/out-of-window/mismatched export returns PARTIAL and performs no write; remote URLs are rejected without network access.
behavioral_proof.error: Malformed JSON, timestamps, identifiers, control text or an unsafe project path is reported before proposal creation and does not widen scope.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.

codex_note:
## Codex adaptation

Use `scripts/cursor_canvas_adapters.py:extract_workflow_from_chats` only with one explicitly supplied project-local JSONL export and the exact parent thread identifier. The adapter limits the time window, includes child evidence only when linked to that parent, redacts credentials/paths/contacts, and writes only a reviewable proposal plus receipt; it never writes a skill, rule, memory or global setting. Native task-history acquisition and automatic selection remain unavailable.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Extract durable working preferences from recent Cursor chats and convert them into skills, rules, or workflow docs. Use when asked to learn preferences, mine feedback, personalize workflows, or generate team/person-specific agent guidance.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic build establish provenance. The bounded adapter test proves parent/child scope, seven-day filtering, corroboration, redaction, local proposal/receipt output, remote/missing-history partial results, malformed-input rejection, explicit-only refusal and write-free error paths. Native task-history acquisition, automatic selection and durable writeback remain unproven.
reason: Per-skill Codex contract adds native mapping, permission gates, behavior proof, promotion state, security retention, and pinned README provenance without changing upstream source text.
